in_sanskrit.name: Monalisa
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Desirable, Beautiful
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Monalisa एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Monalisa is derived from the Italian name Mona Lisa, which means 'resembling or similar to Mona.' In Hindu mythology, the name may be associated with the goddess Lakshmi, symbolizing beauty and prosperity.
